request.description: 能力发现：哪些 kind 注册了、后端配没配、各有哪些阶段。前端据此决定按钮显不显示,别用 POST 试探 503。
起一次转换。kind ∈ parse|stt|identify|summary。命中缓存回 200 + 既有记录,新建回 201 + Location。派生类 kind（summary/identify）用 `input` 指向上游那条 conversion。`force:true` 无视缓存重跑。
默认**不驮 result**（一集播客的 segments 是数千条对象）；expand=result 才带正文。游标锚在 id 上（按创建序单调）,不是 updated_at——老行被 touch 会跳进已读过的页里漏条目。

取消并删除：在跑的中止、排队的出队、历史的直接删。语义是「消灭这个意图和它的产物」,所以不另设 cancel 端点。

request.description: 上报(upsert)一集/一部的播放进度。`:key` 是 URL-encoded 的播放键(影视=leftKey)。校验:position/duration 为有限数且 ≥0,workKey/workTitle 非空,否则 400。「看完」由服务端判定(position>0 且 剩余<30s 或 >98%),看完的记录保留但不上继续观看墙。
读单个键的续播位置。返回 `{ position, duration, updatedAt }`;从没看过则返回 `null`(200,不是 404)。
「继续观看」墙的数据源。服务端已按作品(workKey)去重只取最近一条、排除已看完、按 updatedAt 新→旧;前端直接渲染,不再过滤。
手动把一条从「继续观看」移除。

item.name: Images (OpenAI-shaped)
item.description: OpenAI images 协议的标准形状（根级 /v1/…，Base URL 就是源）。宿主的适配器：model = 申报了 meta.produces:"images" 的动作 recipe 的 sourceId（裸名不歧义时也认）。/v1/* 与 /api/* 过同一道门。

request.description: List the action recipes that declare meta.produces:"images" — the ids a client may put in `model`.

Run the recipe named by `model` in the user's own Chrome and return `n` images as b64_json (OpenAI shape). `n` ≤ the recipe's per-run count; `size` W×H / W:H is reduced to an aspect ratio appended to the prompt. Concurrent requests for the same model+prompt share one run.

body.raw:
{
  "model": "doubao-image",
  "prompt": "a wok on a plain cream background",
  "n": 1,
  "size": "1024x1024",
  "response_format": "b64_json"
}

formdata.value: repaint this photo in Studio Ghibli style

request.description: Image-to-image: multipart with `image` file(s) (≤4, ≤8MB each) as reference. The reference is handed to the recipe as a data URL. `mask` is not supported.

item.name: Sharing
item.description: 配置分享（stream-bundle/v1）。一次导入 = 一个可寻址 run，遗留事项 = items，逐条 decision。见 docs/API.md「Sharing」与 spec 2026-07-24-import-decision-ledger-design.md。

request.description: Export an orchestration closure as a single stream-bundle/v1 JSON. Optional providerIds / bindingCallsiteIds / netdiskBindingIds ride along. Secrets never enter the bundle; suspicious params → 400.

Import a bundle ({url} or {bundle}) → 201 ImportRun { id, meta, remaps, recipeDecisions, netdiskBindings, items[] }. Items are the pending decisions (parked-provider / slot-conflict / notice). Import is lazy: nothing local that is live gets overwritten before a decision.
List import runs (newest first) with openCount / itemCount summaries.
Current state of one import run. parked-provider open items are live-projected against the store (deleted → dismissed, activated elsewhere → decided) and carry a conflicts precheck.
Decide one item; choice must be in item.choices. 200 { item }; repeat/exec-failure → 409 { error, item, conflicts[] } with the item kept open; unknown → 404.
